data: Does the blue line consistently have a higher classification accuracy than the orange line?

The blue line represents the discriminator with context, and the orange line represents the discriminator without context. The x-axis corresponds to the length of the discriminated sub-sequences. The y-axis corresponds to the classification accuracy. The blue line consistently has a higher classification accuracy than the orange line across all lengths of the discriminated sub-sequences. Therefore, the answer is yes.
